text:
A court would most likely find a contract on Marty's $1,000 terms, without the $50-per-thousand loading charge. The catalog was probably an advertisement rather than an offer, so the purchase order was the offer, and Costco's "conditional" wording is probably not the express unwillingness to proceed that UCC § 2-207(1) requires, so its reply operates as an acceptance. The loading charge is a proposed additional term that materially alters the deal, so it drops out under § 2-207(2), which revises my earlier view that no contract existed until performance.

CONFIDENCE: 60
